university: Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation
program_name: Bachelor of Arts (Honours) in Digital Advertising

requirements.general: Direct Entry to Level 1 of the Degree STPM A Pass in STPM with a minimum Grade C (GP 2.00) in any 2 subjects. A-Level 2 Passes in A-Level. UEC 5 Grade B’s in UEC. Matriculation/Foundation A Pass in Matriculation or Foundation studies with a minimum CGPA of 2.00. Direct Entry to Level 2 of the Degree Related Diploma A Diploma or its equivalent, with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and a credit in English at SPM or its equivalent. A Diploma in Media and Communication or its equivalent. A pass in DKM / DLKM / DVM with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, subject to HEP Senate/Academic Board’s approval. Those with a CGPA of 2.00 need at least two years of working experience. Portfolio Requirement Note: Pass an Interview OR submission of a Design Portfolio as required. Equivalent qualification and/or experience which is recognised by the Senate/institution. Note: The above entry requirements may differ for specific programmes based on the latest programme standards published by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA). The qualification and entry requirements for the programmes will be determined based on the "Comparison List of Equivalency of International Qualifications with SPM (O-Levels equivalent) and STPM (A-Levels equivalent)" published by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA). English Requirements International Students IELTS: 5.5 TOEFL IBT: 46 Pearson (PTE): 51 MUET: Band 4
